Integrate graph-scoped search into the search pipeline in cmd_search() / search.rs:

  1. When --near is specified, require that the link graph is available (zetl index must have been run — the lazy index build from Phase 1 only builds the search index, not the graph). If no graph, exit with error: 'Graph required for --near. Run `zetl index` first.'
  2. Compute the neighbourhood via graph.neighbourhood(anchor, depth).
  3. After Tantivy returns document-level results, filter to only those whose page_name is in the neighbourhood set.
  4. Continue with line-level expansion and heading detection as normal.

Update SearchOutput with optional neighbourhood metadata (REQ-013-009):
  pub struct SearchOutput {
      pub query: String,
      pub total_matches: usize,
      pub near: Option<String>,              // resolved anchor page name
      pub depth: Option<usize>,              // hop depth used
      pub neighbourhood_size: Option<usize>, // pages in neighbourhood
      pub results: Vec<SearchMatch>,
  }

These fields are present only when --near is used. In JSON output they appear at the top level. In table output, the header line shows 'near: X, depth: N, M pages' per CON-013-001.

Add verbose stderr output per OBS-013-003: resolved anchor, depth, neighbourhood size, BFS time (ms).

REQ-013-006, REQ-013-009, CON-013-001.
